message: Held weapon is physics-simulated: _apply_recoil() applies apply_central_force/apply_torque to the frozen held body on every shot. Violates AGENTS rule 5 and duplicates ViewmodelRig._on_fired() recoil kick.
evidence: weapon_3d.gd:258,267 (apply_central_force/apply_torque), awaited at 270; called from _on_weapon_shell_ejected:191. ViewmodelRig already owns recoil (viewmodel_rig.gd:236-238). controller sets freeze=true (controller.gd:259).
verification: qa code inspection 2026-09-21 (addon ea41124: _apply_recoil returns early when freeze is true, BEFORE any apply_central_force/apply_torque, so the held/frozen weapon is never physics-simulated — rule 5 satisfied; the world-loot (unfrozen) recoil path is preserved; held recoil pose stays single-sourced in ViewmodelRig).

evidence: armor.gd:59-68; setters call BallisticMaterial.create_for_armor_certification(standard, level); armor.gd:305 static factory has no callers (grep).
verification: qa code inspection 2026-09-21 (fix present in source)

message: Two mass computations disagree: total_weight/can_add_item use `item.mass` (0 for a wrapped weapon/armour via InventoryItem.slurp) while get_total_mass() uses item.get_mass(). The max_weight gate is blind to wrapped mass.
evidence: container.gd:28 (`item.mass * stack_count`), container.gd:52 (`item.mass`), vs container.gd:35 (`item.get_mass()`). InventoryItem.get_mass() reads extra (core/inventory/item.gd:9-13).
verification: qa verification 2026-09-21 (FALSE POSITIVE confirmed: base Item.mass getter delegates to the virtual get_mass(), core/item.gd:7 + core/inventory/item.gd:9; the explicit get_mass() call in container.gd:28/52 is now kept only for clarity, so container and get_total_mass agree).

message: Blood-loss death logic contradicts its own exported config: the unconditional `<0.25` branch makes the `critical_blood_loss_threshold_ratio` (0.2) branch unreachable, and the `<0.1` branch is subsumed. Hardcoded magic 0.1/0.25 instead of the exported ratio.
evidence: health.gd:476-483: `<= max*0.1` OR (`< max*critical_blood_loss_threshold_ratio` AND bleed>3) OR `< max*0.25`. At <0.25 the third always fires first.
